features.name: Weald Spear
features.description:
When you choose this archetype at 3rd level, as a bonus action, summon a magical wooden spear into your empty hand. Disappears if more than 5 ft from you for 1 min, if you dismiss it, or if you die. Proficient while wielding. Range 20/60 ft; returns to hand after throwing. Damage die d8, finesse and reach properties.

At 7th level: magical, damage die d10. At 11th level: damage die d12.

features.name: Touch of the Fey Land
features.description:
Beginning at 3rd level, when you summon your weald spear, choose one cosmetic effect:

**Aflame.** Heatless white magical flames; sheds light (5 ft bright, 5 ft dim) at your happiest.
**Entwined.** Writhing green vines; a grasping hand always points toward your home forest.
**Everblooming.** Wildflowers blooming constantly; pleasant floral fragrance.
**Moonlit.** Pale length of wooden moonlight with trailing star-like motes.

features.name: Canopy
features.description: Beginning at 7th level, when a creature within 30 ft (including you) is targeted by a ranged weapon attack, use your reaction to summon a magical canopy of leaves and branches. The target has resistance to the damage. 1/short or long rest (2 uses at L11, 3 at L18).

payload.name: Canopy
payload.description: When a creature within 30 ft is targeted by a ranged weapon attack, summon a magical canopy: target has resistance to that attack's damage.

features.name: Steps of the Forest God
features.description: Starting at 11th level, after a successful ranged weapon attack with your weald spear, you can use a bonus action to teleport to an unoccupied space within 10 ft of your target.

payload.name: Steps of the Forest God
payload.description: After a successful ranged attack with weald spear: teleport to an unoccupied space within 10 ft of the target.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.description: At 15th level, after a successful melee attack with your weald spear, use a bonus action to make one ranged attack with it against a different creature. No disadvantage from being within 5 ft of the first creature (may still have disadvantage from other sources).
